visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Joeman, a man with short black hair wearing a black hoodie with a white heart-bolt logo, stands in a brightly lit indoor studio. He leans over a large brown cardboard box on a table, using a light green utility knife to cut through the sealing tape. (2) He pulls the cardboard flaps open to reveal a stylish white inner box with the large black text 'THANK YOU' and a red YouTube play button logo printed on it. He lifts this heavy-looking gift box out while smiling at the camera. (3) Joeman opens the white box to find a personalized card and a large folding paper. He shows the camera the card which is addressed to him, and then unfolds the paper to reveal his 2024 channel statistics, including 2.6M subscribers and 14.5M watch hours. (4) He then unboxes a large teal-colored (Tiffany blue) box that serves as the base for an acrylic chess set. He pulls out two separate trays containing high-gloss black and transparent acrylic chess pieces. (5) The camera provides a close-up as Joeman's hands carefully place the transparent and black chess pieces onto the checkered teal surface of the box. He adjusts the pieces while talking, demonstrating the set's high-quality aesthetic in a well-lit environment with shelves and a floor lamp in the background.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: Youtube年度禮物開箱!. [Subtitle]: 來自YouTube. [Logo]: @joemanweng. (2) [Subtitle]: 每年都會給一些大型的創作者禮物. (3) [Subtitle]: 今年是什麼呢. (4) [Subtitle]: 有沒有聽到那個搖搖的聲音. (5) [Subtitle]: 它是這樣子可以打開的. (6) [Subtitle]: 哈囉 JOEMAN, 謝謝你挺過低潮. (7) [Variety]: #我說在座的各位. (8) [Subtitle]: 訂閱者總數 2.6M. (9) [Subtitle]: 2024 年觀看時數 14.5M. (10) [Subtitle]: 總觀看次數 119.4M. (11) [Subtitle]: Tiffany綠的西洋棋板欸. (12) [Subtitle]: 我專屬的喔. (13) [Subtitle]: 這個就是今年YouTube年度禮物的開箱.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young Asian male with short dark hair, wearing a black pullover hoodie with a white heart and lightning bolt graphic on the left chest.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A clean, modern studio or home office with light grey walls, white curtains, a tripod-mounted floor lamp, and a white shelving unit containing various decorative items and picture frames.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with the sound of a sharp knife slicing through tape, followed by the rustle of heavy cardboard being moved. Joeman speaks with high energy and a positive tone, over a driving piano-based pop BGM. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect accompanies the visual reveal of the white 'THANK YOU' box. Joeman's voice remains dominant and bright as he lifts the heavy box with a slight vocal grunt. (3) High-pitched 'sparkle' sound effects play when the personalized card is opened, followed by the crisp sound of paper unfolding. His speech rate is fast as he reads out the impressive subscriber and watch hour figures. (4) As he lifts the teal chess box, a distinct 'thud' impact SFX is heard. The clinking sound of acrylic pieces hitting each other creates sharp percussive transients in the mix. (5) The video concludes with a playful 'Ding' bell sound effect as a graphic appears, and Joeman signs off with a melodic, elongated 'Thank you' in a high-arousal tone.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Process -> Reveal -> Synthesis -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To share a milestone unboxing experience of a custom 'Yearly Gift' from YouTube, celebrating the creator's channel statistics and showing appreciation for fan support through a high-end product showcase.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Unboxing a specific gift sent by YouTube to a major creator, featuring statistics that promote the platform's engagement.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A highly polished short-form unboxing video characterized by rapid-fire editing and energetic narration typical of top-tier Taiwanese creators.
